title: cert-manager CRDs still declare v1alpha2/v1alpha3/v1beta1 — deprecated, gone at 1.6

detection.reason: the CRDs' version LIST is projected; which version each resource is STORED at in etcd is not

quote: These APIs will be removed in cert-manager 1.6.
remediation: Re-apply every cert-manager resource as `cert-manager.io/v1` (or run `cmctl upgrade migrate-api-version` once on 1.7) so nothing is stored at a deprecated version when 1.6 stops serving them.
verifyCommand: kubectl get crd -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.group | test("cert-manager\\.io$")) as $c | $c.status.storedVersions[] | select(. != "v1") | "\($c.metadata.name) still stores \(.)"'  # each row is a CRD whose etcd contents must be migrated to v1 before 1.6; NO rows = clean

title: The chart sets runAsNonRoot — a cert-manager image that runs as root stops starting

detection.reason: a container's effective uid is decided by its image, which the inventory records only by repository and tag; `runAsUser` is projected only when the manifest sets it, so its absence cannot clear the rule

quote: ⛔️ If you are using custom containers that run as root with the Helm chart, you will need to set this back to `false`.
remediation: If you ship custom cert-manager images that run as root, set `securityContext.runAsNonRoot: false` in your values (or rebuild the images to run as a non-root user).
verifyCommand: kubectl get deploy -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.metadata.name | test("cert-manager")) | .spec.template.spec.containers[] | "\(.image) runAsUser=\(.securityContext.runAsUser // "unset")"'  # an image outside quay.io/jetstack, or runAsUser=0, is what the new default rejects

title: CA/Vault/Venafi issuers rewrite tls.crt ordering and what ca.crt holds

detection.reason: the issuer TYPE is projected; which consumers read `ca.crt` out of the issued Secrets is not a cluster fact

quote: ⛔️ You may need to adjust systems that consume the `ca.crt` from Secrets managed by cert-manager with the CA issuer.
remediation: Check anything that consumes `ca.crt` or parses `tls.crt` from Secrets issued by these issuers: the chain is now leaf-first and de-duplicated, and `ca.crt` may no longer be the self-signed root.
verifyCommand: kubectl get issuers,clusterissuers -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.ca or .spec.vault or .spec.venafi) | "\(.kind)/\(.metadata.namespace // "cluster")/\(.metadata.name)"'  # Secrets issued by each row change shape on the next renewal

title: Certificates longer than 90 days without renewBefore now renew at 2/3 of duration

detection.reason: `duration` and `renewBefore` are not in the Certificate projection

quote: The renewal behavior has changed when a Certificate has a `duration` value of more than 90 days and `renewBefore` has not been set.
remediation: Set `renewBefore: 720h` on Certificates that relied on the old 30-days-before-expiry default, or accept the earlier renewal.
verifyCommand: kubectl get certificates -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.renewBefore == null and (.spec.duration // "" | test("^[0-9]+h"))) | select(([(.spec.duration | sub("h.*$"; "") | tonumber), 2160] | max) != 2160) | "\(.metadata.namespace)/\(.metadata.name) duration=\(.spec.duration)"'  # each row renews earlier after the upgrade; NO rows = clean
